audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty is captured correctly: Vel'Koz outranges Taric's zero ranged tools levels 1-5, Taric takes over at two-plus items via stacked heals and Cosmic Radiance.
audit.why: Taric's only CC (Dazzle, E) is 610-range with a visible windup, so Vel'Koz's 1050-range Q/W poke freely.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Taric's E as 'Tectonic Disruption', which is Malphite's ultimate, not any Taric ability. It also had no digit, tripping the cooldown-digit lint check.
audit.why: Taric's E is Dazzle (16/15/14/13/12s). His R Cosmic Radiance is 180/150/120s and W Bastion is 15s.
audit.corrected: Cosmic Radiance is 180/150/120s — track it and don't commit into a fresh one. Dazzle (E) is 16/15/14/13/12s but has a visible windup, so E-interrupt it before it lands. Bastion (W) is 15s — his shield/link window recycles fast in extended fights.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles ('Rotation the disrupted' and 'Trade his flash window'), so the body doesn't match the heading.
audit.why: Taric's W (Bastion) links his spells to cast off a shielded ally too, and his E has a windup before the stun lands — both are matchup-specific facts the generic bleed text doesn't state.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d -> references the W-link double burst; dontsFull[2].d -> references the Dazzle windup.

edits.before: His engage crosses a knockup — E the charge and read the standstill its rotation.
edits.after: Dazzle needs a windup before it lands — E him the instant he commits, and track his 180/150/120s Cosmic Radiance before you all-in.

edits.before: Disrupt the engage class per attempt. Cosmic Radiance is the 2v2’s metronome — read it before stepping up.
edits.after: Poke him below his sustain range: your Q/W outrange his walk-up Dazzle, and holding E punishes every engage attempt before Cosmic Radiance can save it.

edits.before: Taric wins by landing Cosmic Radiance, denying your pattern, and running the playbook once, perfectly, at your duo’s expense.
edits.after: Taric wins by landing Dazzle on your carry then popping Cosmic Radiance to force a bad trade before you can punish the windup.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: Split Q across both targets, land W for the double burst, then stack a third hit for true damage — his heals can't out-sustain that math.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: Channeling R while Dazzle is up — any stun cancels your 2.5s beam and Cosmic Radiance erases the damage anyway.

edits.before: Ahead, publish: rotation Taric's duo per wave and beam the recovery formations.
edits.after: Ahead, shove and roam: your range denies his walk-up sustain, so rotate off wins and beam his team as they regroup.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz vs Taric - Track: Taric Cosmic Radiance. - Hold the root for the window that matters — one binding decides bot. - Cosmic Radiance spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.
edits.after: - Vel'Koz vs Taric - Track his Cosmic Radiance (180/150/120s cd). - Hold E to punish his Dazzle windup. - His R saves, it doesn't catch you — beam after the 2.5s window.

edits.before: Zone with the threat — the root you hold governs more than the one you throw.
edits.after: Taric has zero ranged pressure and a 610-range Dazzle he must walk up to land — poke him with Q/W from outside that range and punish every step-up for Starlight's Touch or CS.

edits.before: Window economy: convert the ganks, root the rivers, poke the sieges.
edits.after: Keep him below his healing threshold: chip Q/W whenever Bravado procs, hold E for his Dazzle windup, and force Starlight's Touch onto cooldown before fights start.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - E Tectonic Disruption is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Cosmic Radiance is 180/150/120s — track it and don't commit into a fresh one. Dazzle (E) is 16/15/14/13/12s but has a visible windup, so E-interrupt it before it lands. Bastion (W) is 15s — his shield/link window recycles fast in extended fights.

edits.before: Good trade: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer. Bad trade: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: Good trade: split Q across both targets, land W for the double burst, then third-hit for true damage. Bad trade: channeling R while Dazzle is up — any stun cancels the beam and Cosmic Radiance erases the damage anyway.

edits.before: Level 2-3 roots govern; level 6 hardens the playbook; first item funds the poke war.
edits.after: Level 2 punishes his mana-limited heals hardest; level 6 Cosmic Radiance only saves, not catches; Lost Chapter locks in your siege range advantage.

edits.before: Carry by the root — one binding per fight; your carry does the arithmetic.
edits.after: Carry through poke: E his engage, split Q for stacks, and let true damage close a fight his heals can't answer.

edits.before: You decide fights from range: root the entry, zone the pit, and bill the formation.
edits.after: His stacked heals and doubled W-link stun swing extended fights his way — land R from fog before Cosmic Radiance goes up, and burst one target before Starlight's Touch heals it back.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: Split Q across both members after he links Bastion, land W for the second burst, then third-hit for true damage — his shield absorbs burst, not sustained poke.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: His Dazzle has a windup before the stun lands — trading into it while it's up gets you E'd into his combo, not the other way around.
